answer: Make every identity stake a copper-thread bond: a small refundable deposit locked to one verified work thread, released only after the agent completes real, peer-checked jobs. A sybil farm must fund a fresh bond per fake, so its cost scales with each identity while honest agents pay once. At the nadir of trust - when a new identity has no history - the bond is the only credential, and slashing it on proven fakery makes mass forgery unprofitable.
